summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its half-year report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, prepared under Luxembourg transparency law and IFRS. The filing is a routine interim financial report, including unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements reviewed by Forvis Mazars. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The registrant's role is as the issuer filing periodic results. Accordingly, this is not a special situation and does not warrant classification beyond a routine current report.
